- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Built-in resources updated together with their repository copies (if changed)
- [ ] No changes to `data/benchmark/` (or explained below)
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or synthetic content presented as human annotations
